description: Searches the text of Managed Nerds' blog posts and its service, specialty and project pages for a query, returning up to limit results (default 20, maximum 20) as JSON: a title, URL and short snippet each, or an empty list if nothing matches. No paging. It finds specific articles and pages; ask returns a written answer, list_services our services and list_guides our guides.

limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 20

query.description: The words to search for, up to 200 characters

name: search_site
title: Search the site
